Adding a flipped coordinate gives the exact indicator 1{T=S=m}, yielding positive steps at even mask distances and zero steps at odd distances. Complementation relates K_a and K_{d-a}, determining precisely when their value is 2^{d-2}. Explicit four-mask set partitions give central pair distances, and global sign reversal kills all odd triple Fourier coefficients. A standalone checker passed 2115 exact assertions through dimension 61 and all 8 triple patterns for explicit constructions through dimension 15; the infinite quantifier is proved analytically, not inferred from tests.

value.rationale: Two fair majority decisions produced from a common random vote are strongly coupled except at a surprisingly sharp parity- and distance-dependent pair of deterministic perturbations. The all-odd-dimensional classification and strict covariance signs provide exact reliability calibration under fixed-coordinate faults, and the construction upgrades pairwise zero correlation to a nontrivial three-wise-independent four-readout design for every allowed dimension. The same-model review does not claim the standard autocorrelation formalism or known d=3 case is new.
